svg.title: Modernized container image lifecycle platform architecture
svg.desc: Four trigger sources feed into a central Cloud Run cleanup engine, which integrates with Registry APIs, Kubernetes clusters, and a policy engine, outputting to audit logging, monitoring, and cost tracking.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should Cloud Scheduler be configured as a cleanup trigger?')
sendPrompt('How does Pub/Sub trigger the cleanup engine event-driven?')
sendPrompt('What does the on-demand REST API trigger endpoint do?')
sendPrompt('How do CI/CD pipelines trigger image cleanup after a push?')
sendPrompt('Explain the Cloud Run cleanup engine design and why Go is a good choice')
g.text: Multi-registry · K8s-aware · Policy-driven · Dry-run mode · Workload Identity Auth

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Which container registries should the modernized platform support and why?')
sendPrompt('How does Kubernetes awareness prevent accidental deletion of live images?')
sendPrompt('How does policy-as-code work in the modernized design?')
sendPrompt('What should be captured in the image deletion audit log?')
sendPrompt('What metrics and alerts should the cleanup platform emit?')
sendPrompt('How should storage cost savings from image cleanup be tracked?')
